If you choose the last option (generalizable synonym example and reproducible code), here’s a safe starter example I can expand on: show Python code that loads a list of bracketed words, looks them up in a local synonym dictionary or WordNet, and replaces them with an appropriate synonym, plus a discussion of considerations (context, part of speech, polysemy).
